endpoint: Bacterial mutagenicity (Ames), not all genotoxicity, carcinogenicity or general toxicity

ich_m7.section: 6, Hazard Assessment Elements, printed pages 6-7 (PDF pages 10-11)
requirements: Search available experimental and literature data first.
Use complementary expert rule-based and statistical-based bacterial-mutagenicity methodologies.
Models should follow OECD general validation principles.
Expert review can support interpretation of positive, negative, conflicting or inconclusive predictions.
ich_m7.local_limitation: Two application names, or agreement of our custom rules and ADMET, do not establish these requirements. This project does not assign regulatory Class 5 or claim ICH compliance.

local_tools.role: Transparent exploratory structural alerts and exact reference lookup
local_tools.limitation: Not independently validated as a complete expert (Q)SAR system; no-alert is not safety.

local_tools.role: Learned AMES model with retained raw scores
local_tools.limitation: Applicability unknown; TDC training overlap unresolved; fixed 0.5 not calibrated probability or validated optimum.
Current pilot batch exceptions caused predictions to be withheld. Do not count withheld outputs as negative or validated expert coverage.

local_tools.role: Model-specific learned structural-alert QSAR comparison with raw classes, domain evidence and reference values
local_tools.limitation: SARpy derives rules from experimental data; structural-alert output alone does not make it an independent expert-rule counterpart. Reference-backed default assessment must not replace raw prediction. Possible NON remains abstention.

sarpy_method.title: Automatic knowledge extraction from chemical structures: the case of mutagenicity prediction
sarpy_method.verified_scope: Abstract and introduction describe automatically mining molecular fragments/rules from biological experimental data. This supports methodology classification, not validation of the installed 1.0.8 binary.
sarpy_method.extraction_limit: Reader warned of an unextractable scanned page and some font encoding issues; no claims rely on missing text.

external_complementary_example.role: Officially documented expert-rule and statistical complementary methodologies, with expert review and optional experimental-data lookup via Vitic.
external_complementary_example.documentation_age: Help version 2.1.2, September 2017; current solution page also checked.
external_complementary_example.execution_status: Not installed or run; no purchase, account, license or free-access assumption. Vendor positioning is not an independent performance result.

decision: Preserve disagreement, applicability gaps and experimental-reference provenance. Assess methodological complementarity at model level, not brand count. Additional metabolism/read-across or other endpoint tools supplement evidence but do not automatically replace either Ames methodology.
